title.en: An Act Fixing Two Years as the Term for the Prescription of the Crime of Libel and of a Civil Action Arising therefrom.
title.orig: An Act Fixing Two Years as the Term for the Prescription of the Crime of Libel and of a Civil Action Arising therefrom.

text.en:
The crime of libel as well as the civil action arising therefrom shall prescribe two years after the
publication of the libel.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 4, 1916.
